# CI image cache manifest — every image the golden-path stack pulls at its
# pinned versions. This file is the actions/cache key input in
# .github/workflows/e2e-stack.yaml: bump ANY entry -> new cache key.

# Deliberately EXCLUDED (do not add — would break cache correctness):
#   - ghcr.io/7k-inari/inari-server:<tag>  — per-release tag input, changes every run
#   - inari/agent:e2e                      — built in-job (buildx GHA cache covers it)
#   - ghcr.io/7k-inari/inari-operator:*    — private + dynamic appVersion tag
